entries.say.1.neutral: I am not ready to put my life in your hands. We need more time before you ask that again.
entries.say.2.neutral: You seem capable, but I do not know you well enough to join your group.
entries.say.3.neutral: That is a serious promise. We have not built enough trust for me to make it.
entries.say.4.neutral: Out here, joining up takes real trust. We aren't there yet.
entries.say.5.neutral: I'm not looking to tie myself to people I barely know.
entries.say.6.neutral: We haven't been through enough together for me to make that call.
entries.say.7.neutral: Give it time. Asking someone to join your group isn't a small thing.
entries.say.8.neutral: I appreciate the thought, but I need to see how you operate first.
entries.say.9.neutral: I'm surviving on my own for now until I'm certain about who has my back.
entries.say.10.neutral: Let's keep talking and see how we manage before making any commitments.
